weapons.name: AK-47
weapons.profile: Hard-hitting, unmistakable classic rifle; angular stamped-metal receiver, substantial handguard and strongly curved detachable box magazine.
weapons.materials: Dark gunmetal, charcoal steel, restrained walnut or matte polymer furniture.
weapons.reload: Detachable curved box magazine: hand removes and inserts the magazine; receiver action is visually acknowledged as part of the empty-reload montage.
weapons.distinct: Preserve the AK silhouette and its rugged balance; exaggerate edges and material breaks rather than adding ornamental blades.
weapons.portal: Midrange anchor; recoil and visual shake must remain readable while exiting a portal.

weapons.name: M4A1
weapons.profile: Clean, modular, balanced carbine; neutral benchmark for visual quality and all core gun animation systems.
weapons.materials: Black anodized metal, graphite polymer, subtle brushed edges; no expensive or fantastical base skin.
weapons.reload: Detachable straight box magazine; distinct tactical and empty reload takes; model supports an independent movable receiver control.
weapons.distinct: Make this the FIRST reference-quality production gun; use it to prove ADS, reload, inspection, clips and polish before copying the pipeline.
weapons.portal: Default introductory primary for fast aiming and reliable portal-to-portal engagements.

weapons.name: SCAR
weapons.profile: Thick, sturdy premium rifle, squared receiver, visible upper rail, distinctive stock and magazines.
weapons.materials: Factory dark earth and graphite polymer with satin gunmetal.
weapons.reload: Detached box magazine; reserve a separate charging control on the rig for reload and inspection animation.
weapons.distinct: Chunkier receiver and high-contrast slab shapes distinguish it from the M4.
weapons.portal: Steady ranged rifle with heavier movement feel, without excessive viewmodel obstruction.

weapons.name: VSS
weapons.profile: Compact stock and receiver paired with the long, visually dominant integral suppressor. In this launch roster it remains in the assault-rifle UI class as supplied, but plays as a precision/suppressed hybrid.
weapons.materials: Muted metal, aged dark wood or polymer, almost no flashy color.
weapons.reload: Small detachable box magazine with restrained tactical/empty reload motions.
weapons.distinct: Integrated suppressed front profile—not a generic rifle plus an add-on suppressor.
weapons.portal: Stealth-inspired low-signature gun VFX and readable short firing impulse.

weapons.name: FAL
weapons.profile: Long, solid and authoritative rifle proportions, full-length receiver and heavier visual weight.
weapons.materials: Blackened steel with muted wood or polymer stock and handguard.
weapons.reload: Detachable box magazine and confident, weightier reload animations.
weapons.distinct: Differentiate from AK and SCAR with long top line and classic battle-rifle proportions.
weapons.portal: High-reward controlled fire, not the fastest run-and-gun choice.

weapons.name: P90
weapons.profile: Iconic low-profile bullpup silhouette; prominent HORIZONTAL TOP-MOUNTED magazine and compact ergonomic body.
weapons.materials: Matte charcoal polymer, dark gray stamped metallic details.
weapons.reload: The detachable magazine moves from the TOP; use a top-slot reload animation, never a grip/bottom-mag generic animation.
weapons.distinct: Top magazine is a mandatory modeling and animation differentiator; do not pretend it has an MP5-type magazine.
weapons.portal: Excellent fast repositioning with compact first-person footprint.

weapons.name: Vector
weapons.profile: Sharp modern lower receiver, forward-biased angular styling, magazine in the pistol-grip region.
weapons.materials: Black anodized aluminum and grippy charcoal polymer.
weapons.reload: Detachable grip-region stick magazine, snappy and compact visual sequence.
weapons.distinct: Pronounced angular silhouette rather than a generic rectangular SMG.
weapons.portal: Close-range specialist: manageable first-person shake at high virtual fire cadence.

weapons.name: UMP45
weapons.profile: Squared polymer receiver, thicker straight magazine and practical utilitarian geometry.
weapons.materials: Charcoal/black polymer with subtle steel highlights.
weapons.reload: Large detachable stick magazine with distinct empty and partial reload takes.
weapons.distinct: Angular chunky control feel versus the smoother MP5.
weapons.portal: Well-rounded for close- and short-midrange engagements.

weapons.name: MP5
weapons.profile: Compact classic rounded/pressed-metal upper, tubular handguard and narrow stick magazine.
weapons.materials: Black blued steel, matte textured handguard.
weapons.reload: Detachable stick magazine; dedicated visible charging-handle animation can be used for the empty-reload visual beat.
weapons.distinct: Keep familiar classic receiver and slim silhouette, unlike UMP45.
weapons.portal: Easy-to-read control for entry-level fast portal fights.

weapons.name: Thompson
weapons.profile: Distinctive early-era rounded receiver and substantial wood furniture. Launch default uses a stick magazine; drum is a future variant, not required.
weapons.materials: Warm walnut and dark blued steel, brushed wear only at edges.
weapons.reload: Detachable straight stick magazine in the base model; no forced drum-mag reload.
weapons.distinct: Preserve the recognizable historic silhouette, stylized rather than museum photoreal.
weapons.portal: A characterful gun for players who prefer older designs.

weapons.name: M700
weapons.profile: Long, slim barrel and stock, restrained scope and heavy purposeful bolt-action silhouette. Use a fictionalized detachable-box-magazine game configuration for consistent weapon systems.
weapons.materials: Satin black steel, subdued olive or charcoal synthetic stock.
weapons.reload: Box-magazine reload where configured; after each virtual shot a manual bolt-cycle animation plays. Do not loop automatic self-loading.
weapons.distinct: Long-stroke bolt animation is the unique visual signature.
weapons.portal: High-skill precision aiming and clear scope transitions.

weapons.name: Kar98k
weapons.profile: Slim classic wood-stock military rifle with a clearly visible bolt and internal ammunition feed.
weapons.materials: Warm polished/aged wood and slightly muted blued metal.
weapons.reload: INTERNAL magazine; use visually authentic individual-round / clip-style animation rather than attaching a modern removable box magazine.
weapons.distinct: Avoid giving this rifle a detachable modern mag in the default factory model.
weapons.portal: High-punishment, deliberate aim and reload timing as a gameplay trade-off.

weapons.name: M82
weapons.profile: Extremely long, substantial receiver, oversized muzzle area and detached large box magazine; dramatic weight without massive ornament.
weapons.materials: Dark industrial steel and muted tactical composite.
weapons.reload: Detachable box-magazine reload; self-loading animation after each virtual shot—NOT a bolt-action sequence.
weapons.distinct: Heavy semi-auto precision rifle. Make it dramatic through scale and recoil response, not implausible moving fins.
weapons.portal: High handling cost and long sight recovery; keep it balanced for custom loadouts.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.profile: Purpose-built premium stylized modern recurve or hybrid bow; taut string, riser, limbs, arrow rest. Factory model is functional and restrained, NOT a copy of the supplied ornate bow reference.
weapons.materials: Deep graphite limbs, brushed metal riser, muted leather grip and a tiny neutral accent.
weapons.reload: No magazine. Nock an arrow, draw string, hold, release; respawn/nock next virtual arrow. Visible ammo is arrow count/quiver rather than clips.
weapons.distinct: Use unique silhouette and animation grammar; no fake brass ejection or gun magazine.
weapons.portal: Projectile traversal through portals must be clear and fair, with no hitscan-only assumptions.

weapons.name: SVD
weapons.profile: Long marksman rifle, distinctive thin stock/rear form and separate magazine, optic base appropriate to default profile.
weapons.materials: Dark steel plus wood/tan polymer depending on the factory subvariant.
weapons.reload: Detachable box magazine and semi-automatic cycling—NOT a manual bolt action after each shot.
weapons.distinct: More nimble DMR identity than the massive M82.
weapons.portal: Repeatable precision follow-ups rather than pure one-shot fantasy.

weapons.name: RPK
weapons.profile: Heavy AK-family support gun with long barrel, beefy furniture and elongated curved magazine; optional bipod is VISUAL only.
weapons.materials: Industrial dark steel and muted wood/polymer.
weapons.reload: Long curved detachable magazine, not a belt-fed sequence.
weapons.distinct: Rifle-derived support weapon and sturdier shape distinguish it from PKM.
weapons.portal: Suppressive loadout with handling and weight trade-offs.

weapons.name: Minigun
weapons.profile: Visually bold fictional game-ready six-barrel rotary gun and large visible ammo module, robust handles and spinning barrel shroud.
weapons.materials: Black industrial metal, tungsten-like silver accents, matte polymer.
weapons.reload: Swap the large detachable ammo module/drum in a choreographed game animation; NO normal rifle magazine or reciprocating handgun slide.
weapons.distinct: VERY heavy loadout weapon with spin-up and spin-down; not an arena pickup unless designers change the game later.
weapons.portal: Cannot invalidate custom loadout balance: movement, start-up, visibility and portal interactions need strong constraints.

weapons.name: PKM
weapons.profile: Long chunky support rifle with receiver cover, feed-belt silhouette, removable ammo box and optional folded bipod.
weapons.materials: Satin dark steel and dark wood or durable polymer.
weapons.reload: BELT-FED: animate the feed cover and ammo box/belt visual elements. Do not substitute an assault-rifle magazine reload.
weapons.distinct: Belt and cover distinguish this model mechanically and graphically.
weapons.portal: Sustained cover fire; dedicated weight and ADS handling.

weapons.name: Desert Eagle (Deagle)
weapons.profile: Large angular semi-auto pistol with broad slide, squared barrel/muzzle region and substantial grip.
weapons.materials: Brushed graphite/gunmetal factory finish with restrained machined edges.
weapons.reload: Detachable grip magazine and visible slide movement; use distinct slide-lock empty state.
weapons.distinct: Heavy pistol silhouette, distinctly NOT a revolver.
weapons.portal: Slow, high-impact back-up sidearm for precise taps.

weapons.name: Glock
weapons.profile: Simple rectangular slide and polymer frame. Exact same factory geometry supports a later Akimbo option.
weapons.materials: Flat black polymer grip and dark nitride-like steel slide.
weapons.reload: Detachable grip magazine and slide-locked empty state. For AKIMBO, make separate left/right viewmodel rigs, mirrored poses and coordinated reloads; do not merely duplicate the same transforms.
weapons.distinct: Intentionally minimal and professional, good baseline for pistol animations.
weapons.portal: Fast-swap secondary; akimbo trades ADS precision for rapid close-range capability.

weapons.name: Magnum
weapons.profile: Robust classic six-shot-style revolver silhouette, long-ish barrel, exposed hammer silhouette and prominent cylinder.
weapons.materials: Dark brushed alloy, neutral textured grip and crisp rim highlights.
weapons.reload: Revolver cylinder opens/closes and individual ammo/speed-loader visuals animate; NO removable pistol magazine and NO reciprocating auto-pistol slide.
weapons.distinct: This is a revolver in the factory spec, separate from Deagle.
weapons.portal: Measured precision sidearm, pronounced kick and slower refilling.
